name: Arrange
description: Four audio tracks of bounced clips on a timeline
changelog: 0.5.0: the song window deletes the open song -- asked once more, Keep it first -- and the first song left opens instead, or a new one; the tempo row no longer outlives its window (a rename finishing wrote to it after it was freed); requires core 1.30 and gui 1.15
0.4.1: builds on the PC against LVGL 9.4 (0.2.1 merged in); requires core 1.25 and gui 1.15

0.4.0: MOVE across tracks with arrows at the block; EDIT menu: a loop region (L/R turned, LOOP goes round it), copy / paste / duplicate x2 of the region, merge tracks or all tracks into one clip, song length; requires core 1.25 and gui 1.15

0.3.0: a click on a block takes the encoder to MOVE/DUP/DEL (MOVE is turned a bar per detent, the next click comes back; DUP and DEL come back at once; the power button's click too); wider track numbers; the songs list edits the open song's tempo and name, as requests; requires core 1.23 and gui 1.13

0.2.0: project list, clip list and opening a song are requests to the song engine (core 1.21 ISongEngine), filled in when the card answers; a song that cannot be read is left untouched; blocks drawn per track; the selection follows the exact block an edit moved
0.1.0: Generated from the CrossPad app template
